description: Explicit counterexamples show that the original free energy lemma does not hold at face value, and that when it does hold it implies the variational density equals the ergodic conditional density.
limitations: Concerns the original formulation. Newer formulations parameterize the densities differently.

sources.quote: We prove by counterexamples that the original free energy lemma, when taken at face value, is wrong.
The interpretation in terms of Bayesian inference hinges on this point, and we hence conclude that it is not sufficiently justified.
